description: Variation of Condition 2 (plans submitted) to allow the permitted layout via the conversion of office space back to warehouse space in relation to Conditions 5 (offices ancillary) to suit the potential new tenant and to improve the operation of the site and 16 (access, car, cycle and HGV parking) to allow the layout of car and HGV parking with associated relocation of the existing fencing, gates and cycle parking of planning permission 01321/N/P5 dated 28/10/2013 for Variation of conditions 2(in accordance with the plans), 20 (BREEAM Interim (Design Stage) Certificate) and (BREEAM Final (Post-Construction) Certificate) of planning permission 01321/N/P3 dated 08 February 2013
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Development carried out in accordance with approved plans and details:
Submitted and approved with applications 01321/N/P3 and 01321/N/P5:
30061/PL/101B, 30061/PL/111, 30061/PL/112B, 30061/PL/113A, 30061/PL/115A, 30061/PL/116A, 30061/PL/117A, 30061/PL/118A, 30061/PL/119B, 30061/PL/120B, 30061/PL/124B, 30061/PL/125, 30061/PL/126B, 0103498/HL/XX/XX/DR/E/630/1000/P6, 576.19.04 Rev D, SS/017047-13/P1, SS/017047-12/P1, SS/017047-11/P1, SS/017047-10/P1, SS/017047-01/P1 
Construction Logistics Plan dated 18th January 2013, Site Waste Management Plan, Bird Hazard Management Plan, Flood Risk and Water Management Statement, Noise Impact Assessment, Planning Statement, Design and Access Statement, Ecological Assessment, Air Quality Assessment, Transport Statement, External Lighting Strategy, Letter dated 17th December 2012 regarding lighting 

As amended by the following drawings and documents submitted with this application -  01321/N/P6:
90217-2SA-NFTE-PF Rev 1(Proposed Floor Plans), 92044-U2-NFTE-LP Rev 1(Site Location Plan), 92044-U2-NFTE-SPA Rev 1 (Swept Path Analysis); received 12 February 2021.  
Covering Letter; received 30 March 2021.
Single/Three Phase Charge Point Installation Guide and 30061/PL/112B (Existing Plan); received 6 April 2021.  
92044-U2-NFTE-GA-GF Rev 5 (General Arrangement Plan- Ground Floor), and 92044-U2-NFTE-PSLP (Proposed Site Layout); received; 23rd June 2021.
Condition : 2 - Processing, packaging and storage of commercial goods' activities shall not take place anywhere on the site except within buildings and approved cargo containers.

Condition : 3 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as B1c, B2 and B8 uses and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 4 - Other than as specified in the application no fans, louvers, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the LPA.

Condition : 5 - The areas for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles shall be provided as specified in the application and shall be retained for as long as the development remains in existence unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No soakaways to be constructed in contaminated ground.
Condition : 7 - The measures contained within the Rainwater Harvesting Statement shall be maintained for the duration of the development.

Condition : 8 - The access, car, cycle and HGV parking shall be provided as specified prior to the occupation of the development and thereafter retained for as long as the development remains in existence.
Condition : 9 - Prior to occupation of Unit 2 a Delivery and Servicing Management Plan shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Condition : 10 - Electric car charging points to be provided as specified and maintained in working order. The electrical vehicle charging points will have an output of 7.5kW.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved landscape details prior to the occupation of the development. Any planting that dies or is seriously damaged within 5 years of the occupation of the development shall be replaced in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 12 - Prior to occupation of Unit 2 a Travel Plan shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
